_meta.notes: Form titled '2022 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' filed as the 2023 year-end report (cycle 2024) — form_year is NOT the cycle. Cover signed 01/31/24 while the Summary Page and both county stubs print Date of Report 1/10/2024. Amendment 'No' box checked. Summary Column B (Aggregate Total) cells left blank. Cover cells truncate on overflow: Office prints 'Salt Lake County Council At-Larg', Office Sought prints 'Salt Lake County Cou'. County Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p7) are '(see attached)' stubs whose SUBTOTAL cells are blank but whose TOTAL lines carry the side totals. Contributions attachment (p4-6) column order is Name | Organization | Title | Address | Amount | Date (date last); the single Address column is bar-redacted on every row and no city/state survives. Contributions attachment is unruled text under a shaded header band; expenditures attachment (p8) is fully gridlined with dates printed MM/DD/23 (2-digit year; ISO year 2023 expanded from the printed '23') and amounts printed with a leading '$'. Other Campaign Accounts section (p9-11) present and entirely blank. Dustin Gettel 12/26/2023 1500.00 is a candidate self-contribution (org 'State of Utah', title 'Policy Analyst').

contributions.detail: 81 rows (p4 31 + p5 33 + p6 17) sum 10,346.77 = Summary line 1 Column A AND = the TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED line printed on the county Schedule A stub (p3); both anchors agree. Sum includes the 1500.00 candidate self-contribution of 12/26/2023.

expenditures.detail: 37 rows (p8) sum 2,641.90 = Summary line 2 Column A AND = the TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE line printed on the county Schedule B stub (p7); both anchors agree.
